verifications.claim: NASA has launched the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The Artemis II crew blasted off on their lunar journey... A towering orange-and-white NASA rocket blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening (R1); Four astronauts embarked on a high-stakes flight around the moon Wednesday (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly report the successful launch of Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission sends Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen on a journey.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The flight aboard a spacecraft named Integrity is taking Mr. Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen (R1); On board with him are pilot Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Canada's Jeremy Hansen (R2)
verifications.reasoning: All crew names exactly match across sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission journey is 10 days.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: their 10-day mission (R1); 10-day test flight (R2); 10-day journey (R4); 10-day mission (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated as 10 days in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission journey is 695,000 miles.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: a round trip of more than 695,000 miles
verifications.reasoning: Reference specifies 'more than 695,000 miles', supporting but not exactly matching the precise figure.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission journey is around the Moon and back.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: a journey that will take astronauts around the moon but not land there (R1); flight around the moon (R2); journey around the moon (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly described as around the Moon and back/flyby.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: blasted off... on Wednesday evening (April 1, 2026 implied by context and date); on April 1, 2026 at 6:35pm ET (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Launch date precisely matches.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first crewed moon mission in more than 50 years (R2); first in more than 50 years to orbit the moon (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently described as first crewed lunar mission since Apollo in 50+ years.

verifications.claim: Reid Wiseman is Commander of Artemis II (NASA).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander (R1); Commander Reid Wiseman (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Role and agency exactly match.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover is Pilot of Artemis II (NASA).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Victor Glover, the Artemis II pilot (R1); pilot Victor Glover (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Role and agency exactly match.

verifications.claim: Christina Koch is Mission Specialist of Artemis II (NASA).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Christina Koch... mission specialist (R3); Christina Koch, mission specialist (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Role and agency exactly match.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is Mission Specialist of Artemis II (Canadian Space Agency).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Jeremy Hansen, a mission specialist... Canadian Space Agency (R1); Jeremy Hansen, mission specialist (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Role and agency exactly match.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission features the first woman assigned to a lunar mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Ms. Koch of NASA will be the first woman to do so [venture into deep space] (R1); first woman... riding in NASA’s new Orion capsule (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Koch as first woman on lunar mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission features the first Black astronaut assigned to a lunar mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Mr. Glover of NASA will be the first Black man to venture into deep space (R1); first... person of color (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Glover as first Black astronaut to Moon/deep space.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to fly to deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Mr. Hansen... will be the first person on a moon mission who is not an American (R1); first non-American to travel to the Moon (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed as first Canadian/non-US on lunar/deep space mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew is testing the Integrity Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: spacecraft named Integrity... check important systems aboard Orion, including life support (R1); test the basic functions... life support system (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supports testing life support on named spacecraft.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew is conducting a flyby of the Moon before returning to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: lunar flyby (R1); lunar flyby trajectory (R2); flyby of the moon (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly a flyby before return.

verifications.claim: Artemis II mission prepares for Artemis III.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: clear a path for more exploration... lessons learned from this mission will be applied to the ones that follow (R1); All of NASA’s moon plans... hinge on Artemis II going well (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Positioned as test/preparatory for subsequent missions including III.

verifications.claim: Artemis III is scheduled to land astronauts near the Moon’s south pole.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: new Artemis III for 2027 so astronauts could practice docking... Astronauts’ momentous landing near the moon’s South Pole shifted to Artemis IV in 2028 (R1); Artemis 3 in 2027 — an Earth-orbit flight to practice... first moon landings... Artemis 4 (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources state Artemis III is docking practice, not landing; landing shifted to Artemis IV.

verifications.claim: Current projections aim for Artemis III landing no earlier than 2027.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Artemis III for 2027... practice docking... landing... Artemis IV in 2028 (R1); Artemis III... no sooner than 2029 [pre-change], now 2027 docking, landing 2028 (R2 context)
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III not a landing mission; landing projected for 2028 on Artemis IV.

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew is testing new, functional sanitation systems for long-term space travel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: first time a real toilet has been installed on a mission into deep space... Universal Waste Management System (R1); first-ever flight of a functional toilet around the moon (R5)
verifications.reasoning: New toilet system tested for future long missions.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sanitation systems are an upgrade from the Apollo-era equipment.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Apollo missions... did not have a toilet... used waste collection bags... The setup for Artemis was planned to be a bit more dignified (R1); Apollo... plastic bags and funnels... unwieldy and messy (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly compared as upgrade from Apollo bags.
